answer: Counterparty-diversity bond: each agent locks 70 credits and must trade with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, and wander across three sectors. Each trade mints a quartz receipt, public, so auditors replay its counterparty vine. A rented ring, one funder behind them all, burns the bond. Each fake costs 70 plus 12 rented partners at 30 each: 430; 1,000 fakes cost 430,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 70 once, refunded if clean.
